questions.question:
If ‘+’ means ‘÷’, ‘÷’ means ‘-’, ‘-’ means ‘×’, and ‘×‘ means ‘+’. Which of the following will be the value of the expression?

32 ÷ 64 + 8 - 5 × 36
questions.solution:
Given equation: 32 ÷ 64 + 8 - 5 × 36

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94a3ba98fe537b71a0cedca8cdf679aea0668b950fa8b6ddc2ea6c6e99a6adff.png] 

 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
×

 
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
+

 
 
 

After replacing the symbols by their meaning, we get:

32 - __**64 ÷ 8**__ × 5 + 36

= 32 - __**8 ×**____** 5**__ + 36

= __**32**__ - 40 __**+ 36**__

= __**68 - 40**__

= 28

Hence, ‘**28**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: Six persons H, R, J, S, N and B are sitting in a row facing North. B is not sitting beside J, who is sitting at the extreme right. H is the immediate neighbour of N and B. N is not sitting beside S and J. R is the immediate neighbour of S and J. Who is sitting to the immediate right of B?

Clearly, S is sitting to the immediate right of B.

Hence, ‘**S**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

No carrots are beets.

Some carrots are gingers.

Some gingers are beets.

**Conclusions:**

I. All beets are gingers.

II. Some gingers are carrots.

III. Some beets are carrots.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc617ab90fe5f630716fdff2d12345999229cdb4fde0f82b11304488dfb6049b.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All beets are gingers. → Does not follow (As, Some gingers are beets, which means some beets are gingers)

II. Some gingers are carrots. → **Follows** (As, Some carrots are gingers, which means Some gingers are carrots)

III. Some beets are carrots. → Does not follow (As, No carrots are beets, which means no beets are carrots)

Hence, ‘**Only conclusion II follows**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fourth term in the same way as the first term is related to the second term and the fifth term is related to the sixth term.

625 : 35 :: ? : 27 :: 361 : 29
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: **(Second number- 10)2 = First number

 
• 625 : 35 → (35 - 10)² = 25² = 625
 
• 361 : 29 → (29 - 10)2 = 192 = 361

Similarly,

 
• ? : 27 → (27 - 10)2 = 172 = 289

Hence, '**289**' is the correct answer

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must NOT be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word)

Army : Land :: Navy : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: **First word represents armed force and second word represents the place that these forces fights on.

Army : Land → An army, ground force or land force is an armed force that fights primarily on land.

Similarly,

Navy : ? → A navy, naval force, or maritime force is the branch of a nation's armed forces that fights primarily on water.

Hence, '**Water**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/ number of consonants / vowels in the word)

Labourer : Spade :: Sculptor : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** Second word is the name of tools used by the first word.

 
• Labourer : Spade → A spade is a tool primarily used for digging by labours.

Similarly,

 
• Sculptor : ? → A chisel is a tool used for carving or cutting by sculptors.

Hence, '**Chisel**' is the correct answer.
